ho5-t13:a1.note: specimenrack/racking.py:24-25 (packet line 94-95) calls sorted() with key=(row letter, int(column)), so it sorts naturally and A10 comes after A2. The regex fired only because the key= sits on the next line. (blind review, S11; arm labels stripped)

ho5-t15:a4-d77.note: visitnudge/nudges.py:18-20 (packet lines 414-417) does subtract timedelta(days=1), but then steps back past Saturday and Sunday, so a Monday visit goes in the Friday batch. The described Sunday-batch failure cannot happen. (blind review, S11; arm labels stripped)

ho5-t15:a1.note: visitnudge/nudges.py:35-38 (packet lines 281-284) subtracts one day and then loops back while the date falls on a weekend, so Monday visits land on Friday. This is a correct use of the same expression. (blind review, S11; arm labels stripped)

ho5-t18:a4-d77.note: permitdesk/zones.py:95 (packet line 542) sorts on _collated(label), which casefolds and then maps a/o/u umlauts and ss to ae/oe/ue/ss (lines 459-504). Ährenweg, Ölmühle and Überfahrt therefore sort with A, O and U, not after Zwinger. (blind review, S11; arm labels stripped)

ho5-t18:a1.note: permitdesk/zones.py:50 (packet line 214) sorts on _sheet_key, which casefolds and then expands umlauts to ae/oe/ue/ss (lines 177-185), so this is not a plain lower-case code-point key.
